title: Cops Find Dead Bodies in Suitcase Next to Elementary School
description:
Cleveland police respond after a man's dog leads him to suitcases partially buried near a school. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
